description: Test-driven development workflow that writes failing tests first, implements the minimal passing logic, and delegates verification to AIF.
preconditions: Repository working tree snapshot is recorded.
Target module and test runner are identified.

steps.instruction: Author or update unit tests covering the target behavior.
Implement the target behavior in the source module.
Execute the test suite at the final repository snapshot to generate an AIF observation.

verification_requirements: Test execution observation must be bound to the post-implementation repository snapshot.
Evidence scope must cover both the modified source files and test files.
